turns.customer: Need a standard suite for my dog Nala Dec 23 to Dec 27, 2026. What are the deposit and cancellation rules for that?
blocks:
For Nala’s **Standard suite, December 23–27, 2026**, the resort’s published policy treats holiday boarding separately: it requires a **$100 deposit per suite**. To avoid forfeiting that deposit, give at least **five days’ cancellation notice before the first day of boarding**. A late cancellation or no-show results in forfeiture of the deposit. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy))

The policy also notes that major holidays may require reservations **two weeks to two months in advance**, depending on the holiday. It doesn’t specify on that page whether these exact dates qualify as a major holiday period, so confirm the applicable requirements directly with the resort. This is policy information, not a booking or availability confirmation. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy))

turns.customer: Your rates page says it's just 24 hours notice and no deposit though?
blocks:
You’re right to flag the discrepancy. I checked both official pages, and **they conflict**:

- The **rates page** says boarding—including its “Holidays & Spring Break” section—requires **24 hours’ cancellation notice** and lists a **$25 per-suite fee** for a late cancellation or no-show in a Standard suite; it does not list a holiday deposit there. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/rates))
- The separate **Reservation Requirements & Cancellation Policy** page says holiday boarding requires a **$100 Standard-suite deposit**, **five days’ notice**, and forfeiture of the deposit for a late cancellation or no-show. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy))

So I shouldn’t have presented the holiday terms as settled. **The published information doesn’t establish which policy applies to Nala’s December 23–27, 2026 stay.** Please confirm directly with the resort before relying on either version.
